tools.name: search_disclosed_reports
tools.description: Search HackerOne Hacktivity's disclosed reports. Use it before writing a report to check for duplicates on the same program, and to find disclosed techniques for a bug class. The query is matched by HackerOne's search (supports AND / OR); program narrows to one program's disclosures.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: A public HackerOne program's bounty figures: base bounty, average bounty range, resolved report count, launch date and state.

tools.name: get_program_scope
tools.description: A public HackerOne program's structured scope (in-scope and out-of-scope assets, bounty eligibility, max severity, per-asset instructions) and its policy text. Check this before touching any asset.

params.name: include_policy
params.description: Include the full policy text (can be long).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Fetch a disclosed HackerOne report's full write-up body and public metadata by id or url. Read-only, keyless. Use it when testing a vuln class to read the real precedent report's reproduction steps and bypasses before mirroring them on a live target. Returns a note when the public body is thin or empty.

tools.name: list_my_programs
tools.description: Programs your HackerOne account can see through the Hacker API, including private programs you are invited to. Read-only.

tools.name: get_my_program
tools.description: One program's policy and full structured scope as your account sees it, private programs included. Read-only.

tools.name: list_my_reports
tools.description: Your own HackerOne reports with their state, optionally for one program. Use it to check you have not already reported something. Read-only.
